chapter_title: Concerning the Four Works of the Ambassador
chapter_note: This chapter is dominated by a compact, systematic fourfold enumeration of cosmological effects of the Ambassador’s self-manifestation (image, firmament-doors, purification/releasing of Light, appearance of the Light Ship/Living Soul). The only clear later material is the hagiographic/dialogue-style attribution in ¶1, which frames an otherwise core teaching sentence.

paragraphs.core_text: At the time when the Ambassador displayed his image, four great works were revealed that are very excellent and outstanding.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed dialogue/frame attribution: “Once again the enlightener speaks:” (hagiographic compilation formula introducing the teaching).
paragraphs.temporal_note: The clause is a neutral, impersonal set-up for a numbered teaching list (core-style), but it is introduced by a formulaic speaker-attribution typical of the later hagiographic frame; hence MIXED with the frame stripped.

paragraphs.core_text: The first is his image that he displayed in a glorious image.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Purely internal cosmological enumeration (“The first…”) describing what the Ambassador’s work consists in; no citation, audience address, or institutional application.

paragraphs.core_text: The second is all the doors of the firmaments that were opened at that time. They open [...] and shut behind him.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Systematic second item in the fourfold series; wholly within cosmic architecture (firmaments/doors), with no move into contemporary institutions or exhortation.

paragraphs.core_text: The third is the Light and the releasing that was purified by his image. That Light is more than the light that he shall [...]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmological process-language (purification/releasing of Light) continuing the numbered structure; the comparison remains within cosmological description despite minor register noise in pastoral scoring.

paragraphs.core_text: The fourth: He has [made apparent], by the perfection of people, his Light Ship. He has [...] the Living Soul that shone forth in perfection and fullness over the worlds of enmity.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Closes the fourfold core list with internal cosmic entities/vehicles (Light Ship, Living Soul) and a salvation-mechanics register; “perfection of people” functions here as an impersonal soteriological condition rather than an institutional exhortation.
